An announcement from Battalion Oil ( (BATL) ) is now available.

On August 7, 2026, Battalion Oil Corporation entered into a Preferred Stock Repurchase and Conversion Agreement with Gen IV Investment Opportunities, LLC to repurchase specified Series A, Series A-1, and related preferred shares for $19 million and facilitate the conversion of additional preferred shares into 3,494,258 shares of common stock. After closing, Gen IV ceased to hold any preferred stock, the repurchased shares were retired and cancelled, and the parties exchanged mutual releases.

On the same date, Battalion Oil and Gen IV executed a Voting and Lock-Up Agreement under which Gen IV agreed for 12 months to vote its securities in favor of the company’s uncontested director nominees and auditor ratification as recommended by the board, and to observe a customary lock-up on certain securities. These arrangements simplify Battalion’s capital structure, clarify Gen IV’s role as a common shareholder, and provide near-term voting and market stability for other stakeholders.

USA Rare Earth ( (USAR) ) has provided an update.

On August 7, 2026, USA Rare Earth, Inc. completed a previously announced two-step merger with Texas Mineral Resources Corp., using two wholly owned merger subsidiaries to consolidate TMRC under USAR’s control. The transaction positions TMRC first as a wholly owned corporate subsidiary and then as part of a surviving limited liability company structure, streamlining USAR’s ownership and integration of TMRC.

Under the agreed terms, each outstanding share of TMRC common stock was converted into the right to receive 0.043279843 of a share of USA Rare Earth common stock, with cash paid in lieu of fractional shares. The share issuance to former TMRC stockholders was registered with the SEC, formalizing TMRC’s absorption into USA Rare Earth and reshaping the shareholder base while expanding USAR’s asset footprint in the rare earths sector.

The latest update is out from Cimentas Izmir Cimento Fabrikasi Turk A.S. ( (TR:CMENT) ).

Cimentas reported consolidated total assets of roughly TL 31.7 billion at 30 June 2026, slightly down from TL 33.0 billion at year-end 2025, as cash and cash equivalents fell sharply despite higher inventories and continued investment in fixed assets and investment property. Equity attributable to the parent slipped to about TL 18.45 billion from TL 18.64 billion, while total liabilities declined to TL 8.13 billion, leaving the company still strongly equity-funded but with rising deferred tax liabilities.

Operationally, the group swung to a net loss of TL 339.6 million for the first half of 2026 from a TL 326.5 million profit a year earlier, even though revenue more than doubled to TL 197.4 million and gross profit rose, as general and marketing expenses, fair value losses on investment property, heavy finance costs and a large net monetary position loss outweighed operating gains. Operating cash flow was a negative TL 1.77 billion, reflecting working capital outflows and inflation effects, while investment and financing cash flows were also negative; together these trends signal mounting pressure on liquidity and cash generation, with implications for shareholders and creditors despite the firm’s still-solid capital base.

More about Cimentas Izmir Cimento Fabrikasi Turk A.S.

Cimentas Izmir Cimento Fabrikasi Turk A.S. operates in the cement and building materials industry, producing cement and related construction inputs for the Turkish market and potentially for export. The company’s consolidated statements show it controls significant property, plant and equipment and investment properties, reflecting a capital-intensive manufacturing base geared to construction demand.

Its business is sensitive to domestic construction cycles, energy and input costs, and financing conditions. The presence of non-controlling interests indicates group structures and minority holdings, while sizeable deferred tax liabilities and right-of-use assets suggest exposure to changing tax and lease-accounting environments that can affect reported profitability and leverage metrics.
